# Third-party marks (not ours, do not edit)

- `google-meet.svg`, `whatsapp.svg`, `zoom.svg` (D-153): the official Google Meet icon, WhatsApp logo and Zoom wordmark, unchanged, from Wikimedia Commons ("Google Meet icon (2020).svg", "WhatsApp.svg", "Zoom Communications Logo.svg" (2022)). They mark tutor call links ("Join with Google Meet / WhatsApp / Zoom") in the tutor chat, as those services' brand guides allow for join links. Not redrawn.
